business.businessType_note: Global Surf Adventures is an Israel-registered surf travel agency (terms page) selling trips to Sri Lanka, the Maldives, Morocco, Angola and Mozambique plus retreats. The one place it runs itself is Global Surf Lodge Kabalana (Ahangama, Sri Lanka): 12 rooms + weekly level-based surf packages (lessons, bed, meals) = surf_camp. The site we build is the lodge's. Other destinations are recorded under other_destinations[] only; the schema has no home for a multi-destination agency (gap).

description.value: Just a few steps from the ocean, find Global Surf Lodge Kabalana – a wild oasis where footwear is discouraged, chilling out is inescapable, and good times never stop. We are surfing obsessed, and we invite you to join us and experience a perfect blend of wild tropical views and great surfing for all levels. Next set is yours!

description_packages.value: At Global Surf Lodge Kabalana, we provide our guests with a unique, holistic stay which combines surf, yoga & wellness, local culture, and nature. Join us for a special tropical experience on the beautiful South Coast of Sri Lanka. We offer weekly retreats, available for all levels.

concept.value: Our weekly Retreat Package includes daily surf trips, all your surfing equipment, surf theory sessions, yoga practices, ice baths, excursions to Koggala Lake, & more!

experiences.value: We are travelers. But, most importantly, we are surfers. At Global Surf Lodge Kabalana we will take you by the hand through a holistic experience that combines surf, wellbeing, local culture and nature.
experiences.note: the lodge page also has 'Surf', 'Wellness' ('Yoga is in session every morning at the lodge'), 'Nature' ('nestled in the lush green jungle, just a few steps from the ocean') and 'Adventure' blocks, verbatim in sources.md

day_at_the_camp.value: Wake up to stretch and strengthen your mind, body, and soul with yoga in the tropics. Then grab your board and head out with your group for a refreshing morning surf session. A big, healthy breakfast will be waiting for you when you get back. Afterwards, you can either relax at the lodge or explore the extraordinary surrounds before heading out for your afternoon surf. End your day with an epic dinner together with the other guests and soak up the electric aloha vibes.
day_at_the_camp.note: same on level two; level three drops yoga and adds a footage review

staying_with_us.value: We offer just 12 suites, making your stay personal and totally unique – part of one big happy family. When you’re not dancing on the water, make yourself at home in your super spacious and insanely comfortable rooms, lie out on a sunbed by the swimming pool under the palms, hang out in our laid-back common area, take an ice-cold drink from the bar, and indulge in delicious Sri Lankan produce made with love in our abundant kitchen.

about_agency.value: A unique travel agency for ocean lovers. Our mission is to create and provide our community with experiences of a lifetime and pure moments of joy that last forever.

quotes.text: I had a wonderful stay at this hostel in Kabalana. The place was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming.
quotes.author: Maryam, Netherlands
quotes.note: first two sentences of a longer review (truncated by Booking at "…")

quotes.text: We loved the cozy, bohoo-vibes at the lodge: starting from the open-air-bathroom, the relaxing pool area and especially the great breakfast bowls!

quotes.text: This place felt like something inbetween a hostel and a luxurious hotel. The styling was gorgeous, the beds very comfortable, the (bath)room very spacious with lockers and personal storage space.
